participants.character: A former election official turned poll worker, pragmatic and tense.
A local mechanic drafted as a last-minute poll monitor, observant and a bit sly.
A returning voter and longtime community activist, sharp and skeptical.

scripted_turns.text: This place gives me the creeps, but I'm still voting.
You two are acting like it's a crime scene.

opening_prompt: A disused laundromat turned temporary polling station. A single malfunctioning voting machine keeps printing ballots in a dead man's handwriting.
